description.value: Broadway Chinese Restaurant (百老汇餐厅) is a long-standing Chinese eatery on West Broadway in Vancouver serving a broad bilingual menu of Cantonese and Sichuan-influenced dishes across beef, chicken, pork, seafood, and vegetarian categories. The restaurant supports online ordering with a short pickup window, making it a practical stop for cyclists riding the busy Broadway corridor. Its extensive menu — including combination dinners and family specials — offers substantial meal options for riders refuelling after a long day.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 87m; rack (6 spaces) at 95m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at broadway-chinese.com confirms the restaurant is active (copyright 2026), operating at 1410 W Broadway, Vancouver with phone (604) 731-0488 — all matching OSM tags. The site shows an online ordering system with a 'Pickup 15 min' option, confirming takeout service. The menu legend explicitly labels vegetarian items and a 'Vegetarian Spring Roll' appears among best sellers; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or tech amenities was found on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Broadway Chinese' is a shortened form; website uses the fuller name 'Broadway Chinese Restaurant 百老汇餐厅'. No material conflict, just truncation in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant on a major cycling corridor in Vancouver with a confirmed web presence and current online ordering system.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend labels vegetarian items; Vegetarian Spring Roll listed among best sellers; Garden Green section includes tofu and vegetable-only dishes

wow_evidence: long-standing Chinese eatery on West Broadway
